source_quote: Linking GLP-1 to WT-albumin is shown to extend the half-life of GLP-1 significantly (Figure 2), and the half-life increases from 0.03 hours to 8.5 hours corresponding to a 280 fold increase.
source_location: Results, Pharmacology para on mouse PK; Table 2 (GLP-1 row)
notes: Value is 0.03 h in text but Table 2 GLP-1 row reads 0.0358 (garbled); free GLP-1 was not dosed in this study (methods list only the three albumin compounds), value is the cited literature ~2 min; iv not tied to it.
